rows.app: Fresh GTK3 native_capabilities.py Sibling with --startup-splash and a unique app-owned journal; independent Target and Electron primary sentinel

rows.oracle: App journal proves both splash map and main readiness; exact PID/native window agrees with compositor; continuous independent focus/cursor and sentinel input remain unchanged across both maps, with fresh snapshots and warp-return negative control. Idle position is null and positioned coordinates are finite.
rows.negative: One-shot rules consumed by the splash and ordinary allows_input overrides must not pass. Only token-bearing windows admitted within 60 seconds are covered; existing-process activation and later windows are not certified. Unknown dispatch outcomes must not replay a launch.

rows.app: Two actual Wayland client connections: text-input-v1 or v3 xdg_toplevel and separate input-method-v2, both bound to primary wl_seat of private candidate; independent Sibling window for blur/refocus
rows.route: real user-seat IME regression independent of synthetic agent seat; separate synthetic agent v3 stale-enabled/unavailable-IME resources in seat-isolation acceptance
rows.action: v1 activate before commit_state then commit_state; IME done-count commit_string; deactivate/reactivate with fresh state; v3 focus enter, enable+commit, IME commit_string+done, disable+commit/re-enable+commit; send stale IME serial, blur to Sibling and refocus same surface
rows.oracle: Protocol JSONL from both connections: v1 enter and IME activate/done precede initial commit_state; v1 client commit_string serial equals latest client serial; v3 done equals latest client commit count; Unicode committed exactly to actual client; stale serial yields no client commit; v1 IME reactivates on refocus; v3 IME waits for fresh enable+commit after leave/enter
rows.negative: A plugin synthetic seat test alone does not prove physical primary IME, and primary text input must not inherit or consume another seat's serial or enabled state

rows.action: Send target-scoped Shift+a; observe real target enter/key/modifiers/release/leave and zero sibling protocol keyboard events, not just toolkit-ignored keys; release target keyboard resource or unmap target and repeat/refuse safely; then send nonempty v3 preedit and terminate only its owned Driver session
rows.oracle: Target raw evdev a=30 and Shift=42 events and depressed modifier transitions, independent sibling journal has no enter/key/modifiers, physical keyboard/primary cursor/focus sentinel unchanged; after release/unmap no foreign-client events; preedit owner EOF immediately yields empty preedit-string plus done and synthetic leave without five-second delayed ghost composition
